content.content: When invoked as `deccy new -m <summary> --on <id>...` with valid ids, the deccy CLI shall write a node document that validates against the node schema the CLI carries.
content.rationale: Validity at birth is what keeps every later gate meaningful; stating it over the whole document lets the field leaves pin values without re-arguing the schema. The schema it validates against is the one the CLI carries (I1-schema-embed), not a repository file, so validity is defined by the binary's own copy.
